chose: Every `uses:` in .github names the commit its release tag points at, with the most specific release in a trailing comment (`actions/checkout@<sha> # v7.0.1`); zizmor's `unpinned-uses` runs with the hash-pin policy, so a tag or branch ref fails at high; Dependabot's github-actions updates read the composite actions too; CS1 reads a pinned changesets/action's version from that comment.
options: hash-pin with a version comment, enforced by zizmor, kept current by Dependabot
hash-pin only third-party actions and keep tags for actions/*
